text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, snow... Annoying, freezing...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's gonna be Christmas soon, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way! What are you
giving to your Trainer, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What's that about?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You're not giving anything!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean... it's Christmas.
That's just not really my thing...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, but there is also this way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, without an occasion like this,
wouldn't it be difficult to find the right time
to express your gratitude?

Today is Christmas. That said, celebrating with
Narita Taishin, who isn't fond of events, seemed
like a pipe dream, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Umm—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Merry Christmas.

I never expected to get a Christmas present!
Savoring the joy, I opened the wrapping to find—
Inside were 'Paka Petit' plushies of the BNW trio.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...I won this at the arcade earlier, but
I'm not the type to keep stuff like that in my room."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm giving it to you. ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, hey!!
What are you smirking at?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna kick you, you know?!

Even while getting scolded,
she still made sure to put the doll away carefully...

Inside was a bottle
that gave off a rather pleasant fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You can tell just by looking, right? Treatment!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You can't just expect me to pick a present out of nowhere!
I don't even know how to choose one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then the clerk came over and told me this makes the best present, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's true I've seen my classmates give them to each other
on birthdays and stuff, and having a bunch of them
isn't gonna cause any problems anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tail treatment, of all things—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh, g-give it back! Forget about it!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hah!?
I mean, you don't even have any use for it...
choice_data_list: That's why I'm keeping it displayed carefully.
That's why I'm keeping it displayed carefully.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Dummy.

And so, while walking through town,
Narita Taishin suddenly stopped in her tracks, looking up at a street monitor.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: "—Now then, when it comes to the player who stole the spotlight this year, it's none other than this person! An unerring, laser-precise three-point shooter—I'm sure you all know who I'm talking about!"
On the screen, a shyly smiling red-haired basketball player was shown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, it's not that I know it, but—

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, the Umamusume I look up to
took 1st place in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!”

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"It gave me the courage
to work even harder, too."

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"She really is amazing...
Narita Taishin!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... that's how it is.
Narita Taishin looked away in embarrassment. But after a brief silence, she suddenly spoke—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...As for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like I want to encourage anyone,
nor do I want to give them courage."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just running for my own sake.
But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I think it's not so bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Being made a fool of, begging, clinging pathetically even when not cut out for it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But having this come out of those results is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Not bad.

As if smiling back at the red-haired girl,
Narita Taishin narrowed her eyes softly.
